headline: Bruins battle to shootout win while Celtics fall hard in Houston
morning_brew: What a wild night at the Garden. Our B's needed that win something fierce against the Golden Knights, and the shootout victory was exactly the kind of gritty performance we've been hunting for. Jeremy Swayman was a brick wall between the pipes, and seeing David Pastrnak pull off that cold-blooded move in the skills competition to seal the deal was just pure class. It felt like the kind of night where the team finally remembered they have a job to do, and honestly, I am just happy to deposit those two points in the Duck Boat fund and call it a night.

The C's had a rough one on the road, getting absolutely handled by the Rockets in a game that was a total horror show from start to finish. We looked sluggish, sloppy with the rock, and couldn't buy a bucket if the hoop were the size of the Big Dig. You can't come out flat against a team like Houston and expect to walk away with a win, especially when the turnover count is stacking up higher than my neighbor Rick's stack of conspiracy pamphlets. My mother watched a quarter of that mess and just clicked the remote to the Weather Channel, and for once, I really couldn't blame her for cutting her losses before things got even uglier.

Looking ahead, we have a little break before the schedule picks back up. The B's are hitting the road later this week, and the Celtics have a chance to get right back in the win column at the Garden soon. I am gonna use the time off to scrub the memory of that third quarter out of my brain with a few extra large Dunks. Hang in there, because the season is a long road and we have got plenty of ground left to cover before we start talking championships.

news_digest.headline: Pastrnak scores lone shootout goal to give Bruins 3-2 win over Golden Knights
news_digest.dans_take: A massive sigh of relief to finally get the ship pointed in the right direction.

news_digest.headline: Alperen Sengun leads Rockets past Celtics 109-93 as Houston moves into first in West
news_digest.dans_take: That was an absolute embarrassment of an effort that I need to forget immediately.

news_digest.dans_take: About damn time they locked in an arm that actually knows where the strike zone is.

trend_watch.dans_take: The man has ice water in his veins and no nerves whatsoever.

trend_watch.trend: Turned away twenty-one of twenty-three shots faced throughout the night and overtime.
trend_watch.dans_take: He was the only reason we were even standing at the end of that one.

trend_watch.dans_take: If he plays like that, we aren't beating anybody, let alone a team in the West.
